6:00
p.m.

Encinitas, California 92024

Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a â€œWHITEâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a â€œPINKâ€ speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the August 8, 2018 Regular Meeting and August 10 Special Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2018-08-22 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2018-08-22 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Update California Governor's Office of Emergency Services Designation of Subrecipient's Agent Resolution (form Cal OES 130). Contact Person: Management Analyst Jimenez
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2018-71 authorizing the City Manager, Finance Director or the Fire Chief to execute applications to the California Governor's Office of Emergency Services for obtaining certain federal financial assistance and/or state financial assistance in the event of a declared disaster; and 2) Authorize staff to complete an updated resolution form (Cal OES 130) required by California Governor's Office of Emergency Services to be executed by the governing body of the jurisdiction requesting reimbursement.
2018-08-22 Item 08C Adopt Resolution 2018-71
8D.
Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance 2018-09 Amending Section 2.48.020 of the Encinitas Municipal Code regarding the Youth Commission to reduce the membership. Contact Person: Recreation Supervisor Rundle
Adopt Ordinance 2018-09 titled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Amending Section 2.48.020 of the Encinitas Municipal Code Regarding Youth Commission Membership" effective with the FY 2019-20 Youth Commission Term.
2018-08-22 Item 08D Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance 2018-09 Amending Section 2.48.020 of the Encinitas Municipal Code regarding the Youth Commission to reduce the membership.
8E.
Proposed 2018-2019 Environmental Commission Work Plan. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
1) Receive the 2017-2018 Environmental Commission Work Plan outcomes overview; and 2) Approve the Proposed 2018-2019 Environmental Commission Work Plan.
2018-08-22 Item 08E Environmental Commission Work Plan 2018-2019 Final
8F.
Revisions to the City of Encinitas First Tier Speed Cushion Program Proposed 2018. Contact Person: City Engineer Magdosku
Approve proposed revisions to the City of Encinitas First Tier Speed Cushion Program.
2018-08-22 Item 08F First Tier Program Amendment
8G.
Bid rejection for the Citywide Storm Drain Rehabilitation FY 2017-18 Project CD05E. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Widelski
1) Reject all bids from the bid opening for The Citywide Storm Drain Rehabilitation FY 2017-18 Project CD05E; and 2) Authorize Staff to re-advertise and rebid The Citywide Storm Drain Rehabilitation FY 2017-18 Project CD05E.
2018-08-22 Item 08G Citywide Stormdrain 17-18
8H.
Caltrans Cycle 3 Augmentation Active Transportation Program grant acceptance and Capital Improvement Program budget adjustment for the Santa Fe Drive Corridor Improvements Project (CS19E). Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Kellar
1) Accept the Caltrans Cycle 3 Augmentation Active Transportation Program grant of $996,000 for pedestrian, bike and striping improvements on Santa Fe Drive, between Windsor Road and El Camino Real; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2018-80 entitled, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget".
2018-08-22 Item 08H Santa Fe Drive ATP Budget Adjustment
8I.
Public Works General Repair Services Spending Authorization Amendment. Contact Person: Superintendent Ugrob
1) Approve Amendment 1 to the contract with L C Paving & Sealing, Inc, which authorizes additional expenditures for General Repair Services. The original agreement and renewal options for these services are not to exceed the annual budgeted amounts of $217,300 for this fiscal year and $1,086,500 over the potential life of the contract; and 2) Authorize the City to provide services to the SDWD (District) which will be reimbursed through an internal allocation of funds.
2018-08-22 Item 08I LC Paving Amendment
8J.
Structural Modifications to Fire Station #4. Contact Person: Fire Chief Stein and Public Works Director Quiram
1) Approve the renovation project for Station #4 and authorize the implementation of Option 3 as reflected on the spreadsheet shown in Attachment 1 of the agenda report; 2) Authorize the City Manager and the Director of Public Works, in consultation with the City Attorney, to sign various agreements to complete the project; and 3) Approve the Resolution (Attachment 4 of the agenda report) to appropriate funding in the Facility Capital Projects Fund 403 for the Project CF16B in the amount of $73,706 with $7,371 (10%) in contingencies for a total of $81,077.
2018-08-22 Item 08J Fire Station 4
8K.
New Fuel Tank for Renewable Diesel Fuel at the Department of Public Works. Contact Person: Public Works Director Quiram
1) Council approve the purchase proposal from Jauregui & Culver, Inc. for a new 1,000 gallon renewable diesel tank at the Department of Public Works shown in Attachment 1 of the agenda report; 2) Council further authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to sign an agreement, as reflected in Attachment 2 of the agenda report, to complete the project; and 3) Council approve Resolution 2018-81 (Attachment 3 of the agenda report) to appropriate funding in the Facility Capital Projects Fund 403 for Project CF16D.
2018-08-22 Item 08K Renewable Fuel
8L.
Resolution 2018-74 Approving Continuing Appropriations for Unspent Fiscal Year 2017-18 Appropriations to Fiscal Year 2018-19 in the Total Amount of $852,817 for All Funds. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution Number 2018-74, approving continuing appropriations requests identified in Attachment 1 of the agenda report.
2018-08-22 Item 08L Continuing Appropriations
8M.
Amendment of consultant agreement with Moffatt & Nichol, Inc. for grant and construction administration services for the Cardiff Beach Living Shoreline Project (CP16A). Contact Person: Engineer II Milligan
Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute Amendment #2 to the existing agreement, in substantial form as attached, including any necessary extensions, with Moffatt & Nichol, Inc. in the amount of $110,000 for administrative consulting services for a total not to exceed amount of $480,300.
2018-08-22 Item 08M Contract Amendment for Admin Moffat & Nichol CBLSP
8N.
Off-Cycle FY 2018-19 Budget Appropriation for the Solid Waste, Recycling and Household Hazardous Waste Fund 214. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
Adopt Resolution Number 2018-75 approving an off-cycle appropriation to the FY 2018-19 operating budget for the Solid Waste, Recycling and Household Hazardous Waste Fund 214.
2018-08-22 Item 08N Off-Cycle Budget Adjustment Fund 214
8O.
Cooperative Purchase Contract with Host Compliance LLC for Professional Services Related to Short-Term Rentals and Amend the FY 2018-19 Budget to Appropriate Funds in the General Fund Finance Department. Contact Person: Director of Finance/City Treasurer McBroome
1) Authorize the City Manager or her designee in Coordination with the City Attorney to Execute a Professional Services Contract with Host Compliance LLC related to Short-term Rentals for a Term of One-Year with an Option to Extend Three Additional One-Year Periods, for a Total Term of Four-Years and a Not to Exceed Amount of $150,300; and 2) Approve Resolution No. 2018-82 Amending the FY 2018-19 Budget by $37,575 and appropriating the budget in the Finance Department.
2018-08-22 Item 08O Host Compliance Agenda Report
08P.
Treasurer's Annual Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2018; Investment Policy; and Resolution No. 2018-77 updating the California Local Agency Investment Fund (LAIF) authorized representatives and signatories. Contact Person: Director of Finance/City Treasurer McBroome
That City Council take the following actions: 1) Receive and file the Treasurer's Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2018; 2) Adopt Investment Policy (F019); and 3. Approve Resolution No. 2018-77 updating the California Local Agency Investment Fund (LAIF) authorized representatives and signatories.
2018-08-22 Item 08P Treasurer's Report
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.

10A.
Report on Red Light Photo Enforcement. Contact Person: City Engineer Magdosku
Receive an analysis report on Red Light Photo Enforcement operation of the City and direct staff on continuing the Red Light Camera (RLC) program of the City of Encinitas. If directed by Council to continue the program, staff will bring a contract for the future operator of the program to the City Council in September for approval.
2018-08-22 Item 10A Red Light Camera Report
10B.Ag
reements and Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget Amendment for the addition of a Peak Hour Fast Response Vehicle in the North Leucadia/Saxony Canyon Area. Contact Person: Fire Chief Stein
Staff recommends that City Council take the following actions: 1) Authorize the City Manager, on behalf of the City, to execute a License for Use of County Apparatus Agreement in substantial form, as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, with the County of San Diego (County), subject to the final review and approval of the City Attorney; 2) Authorize the City Manager, on behalf of the City, to execute an Assistance by Hire Agreement in substantial form, as contained in Attachment 2 of the agenda report, with the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL Fire) to approve the acquisition and use of a County of San Diego Type-6 Fire Engine for the North Leucadia/Saxony Canyon area, subject to the final review and approval of the City Attorney; 3) Authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to negotiate terms and conditions for a lease with Fenway Capital Advisors for a portion of the property at 1950 North Coast Highway 101, Encinitas, CA 92024 in the amount of $1 per year for a period of one (1) year; and 4) Adopt Resolution No. 2018-78 titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget" (Attachment 3 of the agenda report)
2018-08-22 Item 10B Fast Response Vehicle Agreements & Budget Adjustments
10C.
Active Transportation Plan (ATP), a component of the Coastal Mobility and Livability Study (CMLS). Contact Person: Associate Planner Plagemann
Adopt Resolution No. 2018-56 (Attachment 1) approving the ATP and directing staff to proceed with seeking grant funding for the implementation phase of the ATP.
2018-08-22 Item 10C ATP report

Adopt Resolution No. 2018-56 (Attachment 1) approving the ATP and directing staff to proceed with seeking grant funding for the implementation phase of the ATP.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
